name: Igniter
introduce:
SAT-209 Igniter
A Medium ST developed by SEED Manufacturing.
It features a dual-antenna head design and a back interface compatible with various ammo types, along with asymmetric leg armor. The Igniter is a true one-man tactical unit, capable of independently completing long-range strike locking and guidance without relying on other reconnaissance or intel support. Its "Lumiflow" core provides faster and more powerful boosts for ultra-long-range tactical weapons.

30068.name: Accumulator Mod
30068.SpecificEffects:
Before actively attacking, if distance moved is <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles or less, DMG <color=#F74848>+18%</color>;
At end of action, immediately gain <color=#F74848>1</color> AP. This effect has a <color=#F74848>1</color>-turn trigger interval.

20404.name: Lumiflow Lidar
20404.SpecificEffects: When attacking, DMG <color=#F74848>+5%</color> for every <color=#F74848>1</color> tile from the target, up to <color=#F74848>+25%</color>.
